document.title: Ginnie Mae Monthly Issuance Report (Issuance Summary)
document.publisher: Government National Mortgage Association (Ginnie Mae), U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development
document.exclusions: Mortgage-backed securities issued under Ginnie Mae I and Ginnie Mae II programs, in USD millions; a securities-issuance figure, not a count of loans

level: 2 — attested restatement of an official publication; not computed by FinanceRateCalc
not_comparable_with: FHA endorsements (HUD's production report counts loans insured; this is the dollar amount of securities issued, and the pools also hold VA, USDA and PIH loans)
any denial figure on this site
does_not_establish: a number of loans, originations or applications (it is a dollar amount of securities issued)
FHA-only activity (Ginnie Mae pools also hold VA, USDA and PIH loans)
that the figure has not been revised in a later edition (check the latest report)
quoting_rule: Keep the publisher, the edition, the month and the unit (USD millions of securities issued) with the figure. It is a securities-issuance amount: do not present it as a loan count, an FHA-only figure, an origination total or a denial figure. If revision_status says a later edition revised it, say so.

prior_edition_check.note: Only changed figures and the receipted month are listed; 'compared' and 'changed' count all of them. The table restates every month it lists; each is compared with the same month as printed in the most recent earlier edition on file. A difference is a source revision, recorded here and, where the month has a receipt, written into that edition's file as revised_in/revised_to.
